summary: Iter93 fork validation — WhatsApp Delete/Recall feature (soft-recall). Backend: 7/7 pytest cases in test_fork_wa_recall.py pass, PATCH /api/me/whatsapp/messages/{id}/recall returns full contract (ok, message_id, recalled_at, meta_delete_supported=false, delivered_before_recall, warning). GET /api/me/inbox/unified/whatsapp/{thread_id} correctly surfaces new fields (is_recalled, recalled_at, sent_at, delivered_at, read_at). Frontend: seeded synthetic outbound message, verified trash icon appears (data-testid=inbox-recall-btn-{id}), confirm() dialog fires with correct Meta-limitation message and is auto-accepted, PATCH executes, and on reload the message is replaced by the italic placeholder 'Message rappelé · HH:MM' (data-testid=inbox-message-recalled-{id}). No recall button appears for recalled messages, and none appear on inbound bubbles.

issues: Console hydration warning: <span> cannot be child of <option> (pre-existing, unrelated to recall feature)

action_items: Documentation nit: review request states route as /portal/unified-inbox, but actual React route is /portal/inbox (App.js line 333). Consider aligning docs.
Optional: consider adding a Playwright-friendly close affordance (data-testid) to WelcomeBriefing modal — currently blocks all clicks in Inbox until dismissed.
critical_code_review_comments: Backend recall endpoint correctly guards direction/read/age with proper HTTP codes (400/404/409) and is idempotent — good design.
unified_inbox.py projection cleanly adds the 5 new fields with is_recalled cast to bool for safety (defensive good practice).
Frontend canRecall() mirrors backend rules (direction, is_recalled, status!=read, age<=15min unless failed) — DRY-adjacent but acceptable duplication for UX responsiveness.
Frontend uses window.confirm() — acceptable for MVP, but a shadcn AlertDialog with data-testids would improve test-friendliness.
seed_data_creation: Inserted one synthetic outbound WA message (id=ui-recall-475f3a9206, peer +22890000999, contact_name=RecallTestPeer) directly in db.whatsapp_messages for UI test. Cleaned up after test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Fork iter93 recall feature is fully working end-to-end. Backend contract stable, frontend integration verified. Route is /portal/inbox (not /portal/unified-inbox). WelcomeBriefing modal intercepts clicks on first load — dismiss via page.evaluate remove or sessionStorage.setItem('sawali_welcome_briefing_seen','1') via init script.
